approvalScope.A_website_copy: One sentence in the 'Find your bearings.' section of index.html: 'Follow the voyage on the map and see what happens to the fleet.' (option A), replacing 'Follow the voyage on the map, see what happens to the fleet, and look up a person or place when you need a reminder.'
approvalScope.rootRuling: Option A is the arbiter's pre-approved fallback (FINAL-ARBITRATION.md, 'For the root', item 4). The root chose it over the arbiter's primary sentence because the primary sentence's claim that the map marks the place the story has reached is, by the arbiter's own finding, not true at the opening of Books XXI and XXII; option A is true without exception. 'Tap a stop/place' is not approved: the app's map tap handler opens the first stop in route order within 56 px, not the nearest (an app bug).
